description: Searches and compares multiple hotels in a city, neighborhood, airport, landmark, or other destination. Every search requires both checkinDate and checkoutDate, or dateIntent=tonight when the user explicitly asks for tonight. If the user supplied neither, ask for stay dates before calling; do not choose dates for them. Supports occupancy, price range, star rating, guest score, property types, amenities, cancellation preference, and sort order. Returns an ordered list with property IDs, hotel facts, masked wholesale price bands, public-rate comparisons, and Brek links. For a follow-up by position or partial hotel name, match against the most recent relevant search list. If one hotel matches, copy its propertyId exactly into get_accommodation_details or get_accommodation_offers; never shorten, combine, or replace IDs with placeholders. If the ID is unavailable, pass hotelName and optional destination instead. If several hotels match, ask which hotel the user means. Intended for destination discovery and multi-hotel comparison; room-level offers for one property are not included. Exact private wholesale prices are available on Brek.

adults.description: Whole-number total adult count from 1 to 10 across all rooms. When omitted, Brek defaults to 2 adults per room.

checkinDate.description: Required with checkoutDate unless the user explicitly requested tonight. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

checkoutDate.description: Required with checkinDate unless the user explicitly requested tonight. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

children.description: Whole-number total child count from 0 to 8; when omitted, uses childrenAges.length.

childrenAges.description: Whole-number ages from 0 to 17 for every child at check-in, up to 8 children. The array length must equal children.

currency.description: Only specify a currency when the traveler explicitly requests one. Otherwise omit it so Brek can use the visitor country, then locale, then USD. Supported: EUR, USD, INR, GBP, AUD, CAD, ARS, TRY, COP, CLP, SEK, MXN, IDR, BRL.

dateIntent.description: Use only when the user explicitly requests tonight. Resolves check-in as the current local date and check-out as the following date; otherwise provide both stay dates.

destination.description: City, neighborhood, airport, landmark, or other broad destination.

freeCancellationOnly.description: Whether results require free cancellation or refundable rates.

maximumPrice.description: Maximum nightly price in the selected currency.

minimumPrice.description: Minimum nightly price in the selected currency.

minimumReviewScore.description: Minimum guest review score out of 10; distinct from hotel star classification.

minimumStarRating.description: Minimum hotel star classification from 1 to 5; distinct from guest review score.

propertyTypes.description: Accepted accommodation types, such as hotel, motel, resort, hostel, or apartment.

rooms.description: Whole-number room count from 1 to 3. Each room receives the default of 2 adults when adults is omitted.

sort.description: Result order: top-picks, distance, total price ascending, total price descending, or guest reviews.

timeZone.description: Optional IANA time-zone fallback for resolving relative stay dates; destination or property location takes precedence.

user_locale.description: Optional traveler locale from the Claude client context, such as en-US. Omit if unavailable; do not infer it from the hotel destination.

user_location_city.description: Optional approximate traveler city supplied by the Claude client. Omit if unavailable; this is not the hotel destination.

user_location_country.description: Optional two-letter traveler country supplied by the Claude client, such as US. Omit if unavailable; do not infer it from the hotel destination.

user_location_region.description: Optional traveler state or region supplied by the Claude client. Omit if unavailable; do not infer it from the hotel destination.

user_location_timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone of the traveler supplied by the Claude client. Omit if unavailable; this does not set the hotel's local stay dates.

name: search_accommodations

availability.description: Wholesale display availability. A wholesale rate higher than its public comparison is sold_out and has no price or booking action.

title: Search multiple Brek hotels
